name: hydra_research
title: Hydra-style research repo: a name registry, getattr factories and a hand-written loop
origin: re-created from the Sprint-2 audit's research-repo probe (ROADMAP b.1)

expected.defect: the scaler is fitted on the whole matrix two lines before train_test_split
expected.why: the classic leak, written the classic way

expected.defect: the baseline scales the whole frame and then hands it to cross_val_score
expected.why: every fold's validation rows contributed to the scaling, so the CV score is optimistic
an experiment repo whose split moves between runs cannot compare two configs
nn.Module's registries are never created, so assigning self.head raises at construction

expected.defect: MLP.forward returns a softmax while train.py uses nn.CrossEntropyLoss
expected.why: the loss log-softmaxes an already-normalised vector

expected.defect: the batch loop calls backward() and step() but never zero_grad()
expected.why: gradients accumulate across every batch of the epoch, so each update is the running sum

expected.defect: the epoch loss is accumulated as a live tensor rather than a float
expected.why: the whole epoch's autograd graph is kept alive, which is how a research loop runs out of memory at epoch 3

expected.defect: validate() runs the model without model.eval()
expected.why: MLP contains Dropout, so validation drops activations and the accuracy printed is not the model's

expected.defect: the validation loop is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: an autograd graph is built for every validation batch and thrown away

expected.defect: the model was moved to cfg['device'] but validate() never moves its batches
expected.why: a CPU tensor fed to a CUDA module raises at run time

expected.defect: nothing seeds torch, numpy or sklearn
expected.why: two runs of the same config are not comparable, which is the whole point of this repo

forbidden.why: backward() at line 39 precedes step() at line 40 - the order is correct
the backward() call is not inside a no_grad block; there is no no_grad block in this project
neither DataLoader sets num_workers, so no worker process is spawned
the training DataLoader is constructed with shuffle=True on line 43
the test DataLoader does not shuffle
MLP.__init__ does call super().__init__(); only WideMLP below it does not
